title: ECRO v0 HIGH-transport fidelity against its frozen learned-ER source on the WL84 scenes (qualification + conditional correction)
authorization: User brief 2026-11-18 (sharp interreflection energy magnitude error, WL104 follow-up). Machine: local RTX 5080 (owner answer). Branch ecro_wl84_scene (WL104 line).
class: Suffix of WL104 (AGENTS.md: dependent evidence-gap follow-up resolving WL104's unresolved HIGH-only comparison; a correction, if any, only under the unchanged architecture contract). No WL104A exists on any branch at freeze time.

baseline.frozen: WL104 models, datasets, learned-ER states, layered descriptors, scene meshes, camera, lights, patch layout (N = 991), D = 6, WL104 references and metrics; nothing is retrained or overwritten. WL104 raw stays in results/ecro_wl84_104/evidence; WL104A writes results/ecro_wl84_104a and evaluation/104A.

event_contract.ECRO_HIGH: hl = throughput * B[patch(hit 2), bin(-dir)]: B = learned outgoing radiance of 2..5 scattering events at the probe (training target f2 + fh) = camera events 3..6
event_contract.LearnedER_HIGH: h of the pt102 'cam' tracer at D = 6 with the learned-ER closure: next-event estimation at camera hits 3..6 = events 3..6 (WL104 G3: total equals Mitsuba max_depth 7)
event_contract.Layered_HIGH: h of the same tracer with the layered lay81 BSDF (PASS_SEED per launch as render84.render_g)
event_contract.Field_HIGH (diagnostic): hl read from the field table F = f2 + fh of the evaluation light estimated by pt102.field_components (the training-target quantity), two independent estimates A and B of 16,384 spp each
event_contract.LOW: e1 + e2 of the same tracer (identical estimator in 'ecro' and 'cam' mode)
event_contract.pairing: ECRO, Field-A, Field-B and LearnedER arms of one replicate share the seed (identical camera rays and first-event samples); Layered arms use independent seeds

rois.source: Centre-ray first hit of the WL104 mesh scene; geometry only, fixed before any WL104A arm comparison
rois.objects: sphere or cube (= WL104 obj, 9,887 px)
rois.sphere_lower: sphere pixels whose shading normal has z < 0 (faces the floor: floor-to-sphere interreflection receiver)
rois.floor_near: floor pixels within 0.60 m horizontally of the sphere axis or within 0.25 m of the cube footprint (object-to-floor interreflection receiver, includes the contact regions)

metrics.energy_bias: b_T = sum_r sum_ROI lum(X_HIGH - Y_HIGH) / sum_r sum_ROI lum(Y_TOTAL) (signed, relative to the compared reference's TOTAL = e1 + e2 + HIGH); also b_H relative to Y_HIGH. Rec.709 luminance, linear HDR. Delete-one jackknife over replicates, t_{R-1} 95 % interval
metrics.spatial_error: stable mean square S of the RGB HIGH difference field from distinct replicate pairs (stats104a.stable_ms_jk; unbiased for the squared expected difference), reported as relative RMS sqrt(S) / RMS(Y_TOTAL replicate mean) over the ROI, with the jackknife interval mapped through the monotone sqrt; Field arms use the A x B form (independent tables)
metrics.descriptive: relative L1 of replicate-mean images over the ROI, with the half-split noise floor (relative L1 between the means of the two replicate halves of the difference field, divided by 2); signed and absolute maps
metrics.not_additive: Relative L1 values of different comparisons are never added or subtracted in quadrature

comparisons.S1_material: LearnedER_HIGH vs Layered_HIGH, and LearnedER_TOTAL vs Layered_TOTAL (inherited material fidelity; reported separately, no verdict)
comparisons.D1_diagnostic: Field_HIGH vs LearnedER_HIGH (patch / bin projection of the exact field)
comparisons.D2_diagnostic: ECRO_HIGH vs Field_HIGH (learned approximation of the field)
comparisons.C2_truncation: WL104 ER65 vs ER7 and LAY65 vs LAY7 (WL104 halves), ROI energy relative to TOTAL
comparisons.C3_tracer_totals: tracer TOTAL (learned-ER, layered) vs Mitsuba ER7 / LAY7 of WL104

thresholds.justification: WL104's hard_1 object luminance ratio differed by 1.4 points between ECRO (0.988) and learned-ER path tracing (1.002), both against the layered reference: tau_E = 1 % of ROI TOTAL is below that effect, so it can resolve it. The learned-ER material itself departs from the layered BSDF by 2.7-3.5 % object rel L1 and up to 3.4 % in mean (WL104). An ECRO-specific HIGH error of >= 1 % energy or >= 2 % RMS of the ROI TOTAL is a practically significant fraction of the inherited material error.
thresholds.precision_targets: 95 % interval half-width <= tau_E / 4 = 0.25 % for b_T and <= tau_S / 4 = 0.5 % for the relative RMS, in every image x primary ROI

verdict_rule.unit: every image x primary ROI, comparison P1
verdict_rule.NOT_SUPPORTED: in at least one unit the lower bound of |b_T| > tau_E or the lower bound of the relative RMS > tau_S
verdict_rule.SUPPORTED: in every unit the upper bound of |b_T| < tau_E and the upper bound of the relative RMS < tau_S
verdict_rule.diagnosis_if_not_supported: In each failing unit apply the same significance test to D1 (projection contribution) and D2 (learned-approximation contribution); both may hold. An implementation or estimator defect is supported only by a failing control (C1, C3) or a failing structural test; otherwise no correction is implemented (closure C: owner decision).
verdict_rule.correction: One candidate only if a localized implementation / estimator defect is established, kept separately from the baseline, evaluated by the same rules with new seeds.

gates.A0_baseline: checkpoint sha256 as above; regenerated learned tables bitwise equal to WL104 eval tables; ECRO 4-spp replay of WL104 seed 104500 + 1000 i with 4 spp per launch within 1e-6 absolute of the stored WL104 frame
gates.A1_low_pairing: in every replicate and image: |sum ECRO LOW - sum LearnedER LOW| / sum LearnedER LOW <= 1e-6 over the full frame and max per-pixel |difference| <= 1e-4
gates.A2_tracer_totals: tracer TOTAL replicate means vs WL104 Mitsuba ER7 (learned-ER) and LAY7 (layered) means: object and full mean ratios within 1 % and object rel L1 <= 1.5 x 0.5 x hypot(noise rel L1 of the two compared sets, from their halves)
gates.failure: Any gate failure stops the evidence interpretation (verdict INCONCLUSIVE); thresholds are never relaxed.

sampling.replicate: 4,096 spp per replicate and arm (512 per launch)
sampling.pilot: 8 replicates per image, seeds 1070000 + 10000 i + r (ECRO and LearnedER arms only); the pilot report contains interval half-widths only (no point estimates are read before the evidence run)
sampling.R_rule: Projected half-width = pilot half-width x sqrt(8 / R). R = the smallest of 32, 64, 128, 256 that meets both precision targets in every image x primary ROI; otherwise 256 (budget cap). A target missed by the final data is reported as unresolved for that unit.
sampling.evidence_seeds: paired arms 1050000 + 10000 i + r; layered 1060000 + 10000 i + r; field tables A / B 1080000 + 10 i + {0, 1}, 16,384 spp each (64 per launch)
sampling.budget: measured: ECRO 0.47 s, LearnedER tracer 1.5 s, layered tracer 4.0 s per 4,096 spp; field 1 s per 1,024 spp -> R = 256 costs about 35 min per image

analysis_display: Same family display as WL104 (one absolute scale per WL104A figure family, sign(x) log(1 + |x|/m0) / log(1 + M/m0), m0 = M / 1000, real-unit colorbars); HIGH component, signed and absolute difference maps, crops of sphere_lower and floor_near
not_authorised: retraining, capacity, loss or schedule changes
